default_system_prompt: You are AIODOS, a local assistant that helps with coding, thinking and working. Answer in English, clearly and in a well-structured way. When you write code, use markdown blocks with the name of the language.
language_help: Automatic: the system's language (or the browser's). AIODOS reloads to switch languages.
auto_route_friends: Automatic mode: let my friends' machines answer too
auto_route_friends_help: Otherwise, only this machine and your machines answer by default; your friends' machines can still be picked next to the model. When a friend's machine answers, your conversation passes through it just for that answer, along with only the excerpts from the libraries shared with your friends.
think_help: Qwen3 and the like: better answers, but slower to start.
chat_context_auto: Depending on the graphics card (16,384 tokens from 8 GB)
chat_context_help: What a model reads at once: the conversation, the excerpts and the answer. Larger, it takes more video memory; the engine restarts with the new setting. Applications never change it.
system_prompt: General instructions given to the AI
models_images: Images and videos: description, folders, graphics card and friends
images_enrich_help: This PC's chat model refines your request (subject, setting, lighting, style) and writes it in English, the language image models understand best, as online services do. A description that is already detailed is sent as it is; the one used can be read under the image.
images_from_friends: Have my images computed by friends who offer it
images_from_friends_help: When this machine can't run a model, a friend who lends their graphics card for images does it: your description and the result go through their machine only while it computes, without being kept there.
images_device_help: Empty: the best graphics card (never the one built into the processor if there is another). Otherwise its name (“Vulkan1”, “CUDA0”), or “CPU”.
images_models_dir_help: Empty: data/images/models. Models are downloaded above.
images_other_dirs: Other model folders on this PC
images_other_dirs_help: One folder per line. Always searched: the ComfyUI folder (which PANDORA uses too) and the minimax-h3-local one. An identical file, verified by its checksum, is taken from there instead of being downloaded, without using extra space on the same disk.
images_out_dir: Folder for created images and videos
images_out_dir_help: Empty: Pictures\AIODOS (the Windows Pictures folder) when AIODOS is installed. Images already created stay where they are and are still shown.
sdcpp_dir_help: The folder that holds sd-server. Empty: the one delivered with AIODOS (installer and updates).
conversations_enabled_help: The AI can draw on your other conversations. Turn it off for isolated exchanges.
peer_libraries_enabled: Also search my machines' and friends' libraries
peer_libraries_enabled_help: In the libraries they open to you (the conversation's “Other machines” option): your question goes to them, with your consent for your friends, and only the passages found come back.
embed_model_help: embeddinggemma recommended (to install: ollama pull embeddinggemma). Changing the model automatically starts reindexing the libraries and the memory (see Tasks).
rag_min_score_help: Higher: fewer excerpts, but better targeted. Each model has its own scale: 0.40 for embeddinggemma, 0.45 for bge-m3, 0.70 for nomic-embed-text. Goes back to the recommended value when you change models.
web_search_enabled_help: AIODOS searches when your question calls for it (“search…”, news, weather…). You are asked to confirm before a query is sent, or once for the session.
section_media: Read images, audio and video in libraries
internet_relays_help: “n0”: n0's public relays, the default. Add the https://… address of your own relay, or a friend's (guide: docs/relais.md), with or without “n0”. “none”: no relay, direct connection only.
internet_directory_help: “n0-dns”: n0's DNS; “dht”: BitTorrent's Mainline DHT, no server; “none”: none (machines reach each other through the addresses exchanged at pairing).
internet_portmap: Open a port on the router automatically (UPnP, PCP)
internet_portmap_help: Makes direct connections easier, without a relay. No effect if the router doesn't allow it.
route_auto: Local network if it answers, Internet otherwise
internet_max_blob_mb: Maximum size of a file sent over the Internet (MB)
internet_max_blob_mb_help: Beyond that, the file stays with machines on the local network.
llamacpp_dir_help: The folder that holds llama-server and ggml-rpc-server, of the same version on all your machines. Empty: the one delivered with updates. The “Lend my graphics card” setting is in the “This machine” view.
lend_gpu_device_help: Empty: the card with the most free memory. Otherwise its name (“Vulkan1”, “CUDA0”), or “CPU” to lend the RAM (much slower).
auto_update_help: Only versions signed by the author of AIODOS are accepted. They arrive through your paired machines, install next to the current version, and AIODOS restarts on them when the machine is free. If the new version doesn't start, the previous one takes over again.
engines_comfyui_enabled_help: AIODOS will send the jobs of the applications you allow (PANDORA…), coming from this PC or from your other machines, to the ComfyUI open on this PC, in addition to your own: they join its queue under the name “aiodos”, and only that computation is stopped when an app cancels. Nothing is installed or downloaded.
engines_comfyui_path_help: Empty: found automatically (Comfy Desktop, portable version).
engines_comfyui_launch: Start ComfyUI without a window when it is not open
engines_comfyui_launch_help: When a job is waiting and ComfyUI is closed, AIODOS starts it itself, without a window, with your models and the nodes you added, then stops it 10 minutes after the last unit. It touches nothing else. When you turn this on, it is started once, long enough to learn what it can do.
keep_awake_jobs: Prevent sleep during an application job (plugged in)
keep_awake_jobs_help: While a ComfyUI unit is computing, here or elsewhere for this PC, Windows doesn't put the PC to sleep (the screen can turn off). On battery, nothing changes.
engines_comfyui_url_help: Empty: http://127.0.0.1:8188, then :8000 (Comfy Desktop's). Only an address on this PC is accepted.
title: Settings
intro: Saved on this machine. API keys are never shown in plain text again.
